title_cyr: Што ми е мило ем драго на Којник дуќан да имам
title_latin: Što mi e milo em drago na Kojnik duḱan da imam
title_en: What I would love most is a shop in Kojnik
en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Kojnik is a Veles neighbourhood. Stanza 3 lines 3 and 4 ('зик тончето', 'на Спасеви') are unclear dialect; my reading only. 'Бузанчанки' is my reading as girls from Buzanci.
